title: Understanding L1 Regularization
text: L1 regularization, also known as Lasso, adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively selecting a simpler model.

title: Objective Function with L1 Regularization
text: The objective function with L1 regularization is typically augmented by adding the term lambda times the sum of the absolute values of the coefficients. Consider how this affects the coefficients in the model.
